description: Compact ring transact data of each rail and what the ring program forwards for it, the SPP TransactIxData, the SPP instruction data (tag 19 or 21, the data, the configured co-signer on an anonymous ring) and the external data hash over the SPP tag, the data before private_tx_hash and two settlement accounts per leg. Byte 1 of the compact data indexes SPP_SUPPORTED_SHAPES below the default owner tag flag (bit 6) and the data-free flag (bit 7), under which packed ciphertexts take 49 bytes and exit payloads 83 bytes without a u16 prefix. Byte 2 is the input count below the key escrow flag (bit 6) and the anonymous entry key flag (bit 7), the expiry is a u32, delivered and anonymous rails publish no output count, packed slots expand as scheme 11 and the random 16-byte salt follows the transaction viewing key. Produced by custom-rings/interface/tests/transact.rs.
